title: Turn Wi-Fi on or off
summary: Enable or disable the Wi-Fi radio switch using NetworkManager. This is useful if you want to quickly disconnect from all wireless networks without removing the adapter.

steps.explain: Turn the Wi-Fi radio switch on or off. Replace <STATE> with 'on' to enable or 'off' to disable.
steps.expect: The command completes without error. Wi-Fi connectivity changes immediately.

rollback.explain: To undo, set the Wi-Fi radio switch back to its previous state.

placeholders.name: PREVIOUS_STATE
placeholders.description: The state Wi-Fi was in before (on or off)

warnings: Turning Wi-Fi off will disconnect you from all wireless networks immediately.
